name: Prabha Energy Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2009, Prabha Energy Ltd operates mainly in oil and gas exploration 
& production[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
PEL is engaged in power generation through conventional and non-conventional sources, including biomass, natural gas, nuclear, waste, thermal, solar, geothermal, wind, and tidal energy. The company also explores and develops oil, gas, CBM, shale, and hydrocarbon projects, both onshore and offshore.
